question: Do the two GSE153515 donors (GSM4646295/GSM4646296, donor_1/donor_2) appear in the Geneformer Genecorpus-104M pre-training corpus?

rationale.why_not_confirmed: No public corpus artifact carries donor identifiers: the NatCS 2026 SI source table (MOESM3 genecorpus_104m) has only source_DOI/n_cells_passed_filtering/organ columns, and released HF shards contain input_ids rank-value encodings only ('does not contain annotations'). Direct donor-ID matching is mathematically impossible, not merely unattempted.
rationale.why_exclusion_impossible: GEO confirms GSE153515 consists of exactly two samples = two young donors (~18,000 pre-QC / 16,360 post-QC cells); the companion paper (PMID 34297801) reuses the same 16,360 cells, adding no donors. Therefore every cell attributable to DOI 10.1016/j.jtos.2020.12.004 necessarily belongs to donor_1 or donor_2. Given the confirmed study-level corpus row (53,290 cells > total post-QC study size), wholesale ingestion of both samples is the most consistent explanation; selective per-donor filtering is undocumented and implausible.
rationale.why_presume_exposed: Study-level inclusion is decisive (DOI row); no temporal exemption (GEO public 2021-01-14 vs corpus release 2026-03-27); bounded cell-level Signal A search over a uniform 0.54% corpus sample found 0 hits with passing controls - expected under whole-dataset shard placement (~0.6% detection probability), i.e. a weak negative that cannot exclude.
rationale.residual_uncertainty: (i) MOESM3 row could in principle be mis-attributed bookkeeping (53,290 exceeds study totals; ingest details unverifiable publicly); (ii) no per-shard manifest released; full 1,202-shard/600GB corpus not downloadable under project constraints.

impact_on_paper_claims.frozen_baseline_rho_0806: Produced on a test set whose donors must be presumed seen during pre-training; absolute frozen/zero-shot endpoints on GSE153515 cannot be interpreted as leakage-free.
impact_on_paper_claims.paired_design: Unaffected: conclusions conditioned on surviving on GSE299152 (post-cutoff, out-of-corpus, DOI absent from source table) remain robust to pre-training contamination.
impact_on_paper_claims.required_wording_change: Retain 'same-corpus reference' framing; explicitly state donor-level exposure is presumed because exclusion is logically unreachable for this two-donor study.

evidence.finding: Table has exactly 3 columns (source_DOI, n_cells_passed_filtering, organ); row 963 = https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jtos.2020.12.004, 53290 cells, organ=eye; 136 eye rows / 26 unique DOIs; NO donor or accession field at any granularity.

Repo contains tokenized Arrow dataset + lengths pkl + token dictionary; Data Fields = input_ids only; card states 'Geneformer-104M does not contain annotations' and 'no traceable sequencing reads'; sources include GEO/SRA/CELLxGENE; 2,903 datasets ~= 104M cells; release lastModified 2026-03-27.
Series has exactly 2 samples (GSM4646295, GSM4646296); 'limbal basal cells from two young donors'; ~18,000 cells pre-QC, 16,360 retained after Seurat QC; linked PMIDs 33388438 and 34297801.
LSC_scRNAseq_1, Corneoscleral tissues-1, Lions Eye Bank of Texas; characteristics = 'tissue: Corneoscleral tissues' only - no age/sex/donor identifier available for cross-matching.
LSC_scRNAseq_2, Corneoscleral tissues-2, same eye bank; no donor identifiers.
Li et al., Ocul Surf 2021, DOI 10.1016/j.jtos.2020.12.004 analyzes exactly the 16,360 limbal basal cells of these two donors; MeSH Female+Male (one donor each sex).
Companion paper Li et al., IOVS 2021 (DOI 10.1167/iovs.62.9.36) reuses the same 16,360 cells from the same two donors - adds no additional donors to the DOI's data footprint.

HOSA collection curated by Rui Chen (UCI); current collection version created 2026-06-10, AFTER corpus release 2026-03-27; earliest dataset versions published 2025-05-05; collection presence inside Genecorpus-104M NOT verifiable via the DOI table (its journal/CAP DOIs absent; cellxgene-sourced corpus rows show no eye organ).

HOSA all-cells dataset (61adb974-beea-432e-9b4f-677d9cb22ece, 577,857 cells) discloses 50 donor_id labels (shi_donor1-4, chen_donor1-2, li_donor72/73/75/76, chakravarti_Cornea1-3, dickman_Cornea01-08+pooled, BCM_* x20, 246Z/257T/283P/719I, Atlanta_A230245, LEI_22_49449); fetal version has 74 donors. No label demonstrably maps to GSM4646295/96 donors; no public donor-to-source-study mapping published.
'publicly available datasets were integrated... over 1 million cells and nuclei from 102 donors' - integration of public data confirmed but donor provenance table unpublished.
Project carries internal CAP DOI 10.57772/cap.lr1qubc8lvq53byicflpmnedecs2.565; no journal DOI; no donor/sample mapping exposed.

Largest eye-row bioRxiv DOI (1,378,557 cells) resolves to an integrated RETINA atlas (Li/Luecken/Monavarfeshani et al.), not the ocular surface atlas - rules out conflation when reading the corpus table.

scContam Signal A over 7 uniform shards (557,524 fingerprints = 0.54% of corpus): 15,827 GSE153515 query fingerprints -> 0 hits at Jaccard>=0.5, max top Jaccard 0.0 (both encoding modes); positive control recall 100% (median Jaccard 1.0); negative control 0 false positives. Detection probability under single-shard placement ~0.6% => weak negative, non-excluding.

recommended_upgrades: Contact Chen & Venkatesh / Theodoris lab for the ingestion source (GEO accession, matrix version) of the 10.1016/j.jtos.2020.12.004 row and availability of a per-shard/per-dataset manifest - the only path that could upgrade verdict to confirmed/excluded.

Locally inspect training-atlas chen_* libraries (obs) for any GSE153515-derived entries (LSC_scRNAseq labels / barcodes / 16,360-cell footprint) to close the adjacent training-side naming risk (outside M5 scope).
If GPU window opens, measure frozen zero-shot endpoints on GSE299152 to empirically bound the same-corpus leakage inflation on frozen metrics.
